title: carex riparia subsp. chilensis
intro: Carex riparia subsp. chilensis, commonly known as Chilean sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Carex riparia subsp. chilensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. These actions may contribute to its potential therapeutic uses in wound healing, skin care, and immune system support, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
